refnamediv.refpurpose: Associates all key-value pairs of a traversable object or array

refentry.refsect1:
&reftitle.description;
public voidDs\Map::putAll mixedvalues
Associates all key-value values of a Traversable object or &array;.
Keys of type object are supported.
If an object implements Ds\Key, equality will be determined by the object's Ds\Key::equals function.
If an object does not implement Ds\Key, objects must be references to the same instance to be considered equal.

&reftitle.errors;
Throws an InvalidArgumentException if values is neither an array nor a Traversable object.
